files_summary.commits.json: Array of commit objects representing the full commit history of the repository. Each object includes the commit hash, author name, author email, date, and commit message.
files_summary.branches.json: Array of branch objects describing all branches in the repository. Each object contains the branch name, a boolean indicating if it is the current branch, the latest commit hash on that branch, and the commit message of that latest commit.
files_summary.tags.json: Array of tag objects for repository tags. Each object provides the tag name, the associated commit hash, the tag message, and the date the tag was created.
files_summary.repo_structure.json: JSON representation of the repository's file tree. It includes the repository root path and a list of files with their relative paths, file types (e.g., markdown, python, text), and a brief description of each file's purpose.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_commits
tool_schemas.description: Lists commits from the repository history and returns commit objects, optionally filtered by author name and/or a since–until date-time range, up to the requested limit. The request is refused if limit is not an integer or is outside allowed bounds, if since/until are not valid date-time values, or if since is later than until. Filters that match no history are allowed and simply return an empty list.

limit.description: Maximum number of commits to return.

author.description: Filter commits by the author's name.

tool_schemas.name: get_commit
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the commit object identified by the provided commit hash. The request is refused if commit_hash is missing, not a valid-looking hash value, or does not correspond to a commit that exists in the repository history. It is also refused when the repository has no accessible history to search.

commit_hash.description: The SHA hash of the commit to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_branches
tool_schemas.description: Lists branches in the repository and returns branch objects, optionally restricted to the currently checked-out branch and/or to branches whose names contain the provided substring. The request is refused if current_only is not a boolean or name_filter is not a string. If current_only is true but there is no currently checked-out branch available to report, the request is refused.

current_only.description: If true, only return the currently checked-out branch.

name_filter.description: Return only branches whose name contains this substring.

tool_schemas.name: get_branch
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the branch object with the exact provided branch name. The request is refused if branch_name is missing, empty, or does not match any branch in the repository. It is also refused if the repository’s branches are not accessible at the time of the request.

branch_name.description: The exact name of the branch to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: List tag objects, optionally filtering by name and limiting the number of results.

name_filter.description: Return only tags whose name contains this substring.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_tag
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the tag object with the exact provided tag name. The request is refused if tag_name is missing, empty, or does not match any tag in the repository. It is also refused if tags cannot be read from the repository at the time of the request.

tag_name.description: The exact name of the tag to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_repo_structure
tool_schemas.description: Returns the repository’s file tree structure and, when path_filter is provided, includes only entries whose relative path contains that substring. The request is refused if path_filter is provided but is not a string. It is also refused when the repository structure cannot be enumerated or is not available to the service.

path_filter.description: Only include files whose relative_path contains this substring.

tool_schemas.name: find_file
tool_schemas.description: Finds a single file by its relative path within the repository structure and returns that file’s metadata. The request is refused if file_path is missing, empty, or not a valid relative path for this repository, or if no file exists at that path. It is also refused when the repository structure is unavailable, preventing the lookup.

file_path.description: The relative path of the file to locate.

metadata.name: Chronicle Repository Navigator
metadata.description: Provides a unified API to explore a source repository’s history and layout, including commits, branches, tags, directory structure, and file lookup.
